dedupe_keys.name: soll fahrplandaten gtfs general transit feed specification

description: Soll-Fahrplandaten (GTFS - General Transit Feed Specification) is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. In dieser Ressource hinterlegen wir stets den aktuellsten GTFS-Datensatz. Dieser wird ca. wöchentlich aktualisiert.Datensätze im GTFS-Format umfassen Informationen zu Linien, Haltestellen, Verläufen, Fahrplandaten usw. und werden unter anderem in Kartendiensten wie google-Maps integriert.GTFS steht für General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) und stammt urspünglich aus dem Hause Google. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are gtfs, opendata-öpnv. It offers 15 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/TXT, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
